fullPassage: We have a 'diving reflex', like other marine mammals. This means that special nerve endings on our faces, around the mouth and nose, trigger this reflex only when the facial region goes under water. If we are in the water, with our head out in the air, there is no diving reflex. But if we sink just our face in a bowl of water, while the whole of the rest of our body is in the dry air, the diving reflex is triggered. It automatically closes down the airway, reducing the risk of swallowing water, and it narrows the small air-passages in the lungs. At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them from the effects of the brief stop in breathing. By contrast, if a chimpanzee or a gorilla found itself in water with its face below the surface, it would panic, its heart would race and it would quickly drown.

questions.passage: We have a 'diving reflex', like other marine mammals. This means that special nerve endings on our faces, around the mouth and nose, trigger this reflex only when the facial region goes under water. If we are in the water, with our head out in the air, there is no diving reflex. But if we sink just our face in a bowl of water, while the whole of the rest of our body is in the dry air, the diving reflex is triggered. It automatically closes down the airway, reducing the risk of swallowing water, and it narrows the small air-passages in the lungs. At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting <u>them</u> from the effects of the brief stop in breathing. By contrast, if a chimpanzee or a gorilla found itself in water with its face below the surface, it would panic, its heart would race and it would quickly drown.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 'blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them'에서 them은 the vital organs를 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ① 중요 장기(the vital organs): 'blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them'에서 them은 바로 앞의 the vital organs를 지칭 ←정답

❌ ② 해양 포유류: marine mammals는 멀리 있고 문맥상 보호 대상이 아님

❌ ③ 침팬지와 고릴라: 뒤 문장에 등장하며 them의 선행사가 아님

❌ ④ 작은 기도들: air-passages는 them이 가리키는 대상이 아님
det.tip: shunted to the vital organs, protecting them — them = the vital organs
